Reviews financial position of Panchayats every five years and recommends distribution of funds.

items: Article 243I specifically pertains to the State Finance Commission reviewing Panchayati Raj Institutions.
Questions often test the frequency of review, which is strictly every five years.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The State Finance Commission is governed by Article 243I of the Constitution.
It conducts a thorough review of the financial position of Panchayats at regular five-year intervals.
The commission's core role is to recommend the principles governing the distribution of financial resources and funds.
